text:
nina: Quick sync - marketplace listing launch next Wed APAC morning. Need owners for press, microsite swap, SI callouts, and legal signoff.

sam: I'll take press + media list. Draft PR in GDrive. Need partner quotes from SI-1 and SI-2.

tariq: Microsite and CDN cutover owned by me. Cutover steps: flip feature flag, CDN purge, monitor 200s and hero image. Dry-run on staging tomorrow 02:00 SGT.

ellie: Legal check: logos for HW partners approved except HW-Z (awaiting final). If not signed by EOD APAC we'll hide their tile.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance 6335559000 - releases blocked during window.

nina: Good call, ops-bot. Keep cutover before that. Propose embargo lift 00:45 SGT, blog 01:00 SGT, microsite swap 01:15 SGT. Thoughts?

sam: Works for press. I'll circulate embargo times to media with plaintext table + delivery channels.

tariq: I'll set Cache-Control: no-cache during swap and a 15min rollback window controlled by flag. Will post runbook to #eng-oncall.

ellie: Pinging HW-Z legal now. If no response, we'll use placeholder "Coming soon" tile.

nina: Owners: nina (overall), sam (press/blog), tariq (cutover/runbook), ellie (partner signoffs). Reply here when your item is done. :white_check_mark:

sam: Sent embargo table to press list.

tariq: Dry-run success on staging. Minor asset path fix applied.

ellie: HW-Z approved and assets uploaded.

nina: Perfect. Final check: UTMs added, l10n owners briefed, on-call notified. We'll execute on schedule. Ping in #launch-room if anything changes. :rocket:
